newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-NUNO SET TO MOVE TO DEPORTIVO CORUNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NUNO SET TO MOVE TO DEPORTIVO CORUNA.

text.p: Vitoria Guimaraes goalkeeper Nuno Santo is set to move to Spain's Deportivo Coruna in a move worth about $3 million, the Portuguese club said on Wednesday.
Guimaraes chairman Antonio Pimenta Machado told journalists his club would also get former Yugoslav midfielder Branko Milovanovic for four seasons.
"I received a proposal from the Spanish club...worth $3million," Pimenta Machado said. He said he was prepared to let the player go but the final decision rested with the club's board of directors.
Nuno Santo, known as Nuno, has been locked in a battle of wills with Guimaraes since returning from the Atlanta Olympics in which he played for Portugal.
The 21-year-old player had demanded a move but Guimaraes said initially that he had to serve out the remainder of his contract which expires in 1999.
